note: Summaries of each retailer's published return policy, checked on the date shown. Only short phrases are quoted. A rule marked unknown is treated as not returnable once opened.

retailers.name: Sephora

rules.conditions: Refund for items in "new or gently used" condition within 30 days of purchase.

retailers.notes: The main returns page blocked automated reading on the check date; the window and condition come from Sephora's own payment FAQ.

rules.conditions: Refund for "new or gently used" products within 30 days; days 31-60 give merchandise credit only. All original components, proof of purchase and a government ID are required.
Most beauty items can be returned "even if opened" within 90 days with a receipt (120 with a Target Circle Card).
Opened electronics are "eligible only for exchange" and must come back within 30 days.
Refunds cover "most unopened items" in new condition within 90 days.
Most new, unopened items within 60 days; items that are opened "may be denied a refund or exchange", and some personal care products cannot be returned at all.
Most new, unopened items within 60 days; opened items may be refused.
Cosmetics returns are "at the discretion of the store manager", usually as a Walgreens gift card; eligible items within 30 days with a receipt.
Electronics returns are at the store manager's discretion, usually as a gift card.
Eligible items within 30 days with the receipt or order number; the page does not say whether opened items qualify.

retailers.name: Kohl's

rules.conditions: Sephora at Kohl's items come back in "new or gently used" condition within 30 days. A Kohl's holiday post cites 60 days for the same items; the shorter window is used.
Premium electronics within 30 days; the pages read do not say whether opened items qualify.
Most merchandise within 90 days (120 with a Kohl's Card), with or without a receipt; opened condition is not addressed.

retailers.notes: kohls.com blocked automated reading on the check date; windows come from Kohl's indexed help pages and corporate news posts.

rules.conditions: Policies vary by brand; not checked. Treated as not returnable once opened until the store's page is read.
